target.memberships_query: SELECT PlaylistId, TrackId FROM PlaylistMembership ORDER BY PlaylistId, TrackId

protected_records.Playlist: SELECT PlaylistId, Name FROM Playlist ORDER BY PlaylistId
protected_records.PlaylistTrack: SELECT PlaylistId, TrackId FROM PlaylistTrack ORDER BY PlaylistId, TrackId
protected_records.Track: SELECT * FROM Track ORDER BY TrackId
protected_records.Invoice: SELECT * FROM Invoice ORDER BY InvoiceId
protected_records.InvoiceLine: SELECT * FROM InvoiceLine ORDER BY InvoiceLineId

application_queries: SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt USING(PlaylistId) GROUP BY p.PlaylistId ORDER BY p.PlaylistId
index_query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type='index' AND tbl_name IN ('Playlist','PlaylistTrack','Track','Invoice','InvoiceLine') ORDER BY name
